name: Google sign-in completes and the dashboard shows the Google profile
title: SC-06-05-02 Google sign-in completes and the dashboard shows the Google profile
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the user is on the SitePulse login screen
When they tap "Google ile Giriş Yap"
Then the Google authentication flow completes
And the app dashboard updates to show their Google profile picture and permissions
